original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: The Roadward Lodge toll beam stands open beside orderly shield and spear bundles, bright road lanterns, and a teal claim pennant.
The three kennel bays stand open with clean bowls, packed bedrolls, a bright handler lantern, and teal claim ribbons.
The Cliffhawk Roost has a repaired teal canopy, packed nest platform, glowing signal crystals, and a clean claim streamer.
The reed barge is tied to an active pier under a clean teal canopy with packed crates, route rope, and a bright lantern.
The Glowcap Croft door stands open to warm light beside a tended fungus bed, packed satchels, and a teal fence ribbon.
The Dustjack Yard is tidied into spear and bow racks beside packed blankets, a supply chest, lit lantern, and teal pennant.
The Cinder Kiln burns steadily beside ordered cinder pots, travel packs, a clean smoke plume, and a teal claim ribbon.
The Frostbeacon Bothy has a bright cyan beacon, open warm doorway, cleared steps, winter packs, and spare pikes ready.
The Orchard Levy storehouse stands open beneath laden boughs, ordered levy pikes, packed fruit stores, working lanterns, and teal claim pennants.
The Bramble Hedge passage stands trimmed and open beside ordered bows, quivers, field packs, a warm lantern, and teal claim ribbons.
The Tidepool skiff rests ready beside ordered oars, nets, rope, supply boxes, a bright pier lantern, and teal signal sails.
The Switchback Hostel glows with open access, bright windows, ordered pikes, shields, travel packs, and teal route pennants.
The Saltpan Camp holds worked trays, filled sacks, ordered bucklers and throwing spears beneath a clean teal-and-ivory canopy.
The Crystal Sump shines around a secured lifting bucket, ordered stone shields and dart cases, and a teal claim ribbon.
The Icehook Lodge door stands warm and open beside cleared steps, ordered hooks, traps, pikes, winter packs, and teal claim cloth.
The Obsidian Scar burns steadily behind an open chain, ordered black shields, ash darts, travel packs, and teal claim pennants.
The Harbor Pilot House and mast glow beside ordered polearms, oars, flare crates, coiled rope, and teal signal cloth.
The Kite Signal Eyrie holds taut lines, a bright signal fire, ordered ridge bows, route packs, and teal claim pennants.
The Lantern Warren opens under bright lamps beside ordered packs, needle cases, small shields, and teal claim ribbons.
The Bogbell Croft has cleared steps, a lit bell and lamps, ordered mauls, peat jars, packs, and teal claim ribbons.
The Milestone Arsenal stands open around ready bucklers, pikes, cartbows, bolt crates, field packs, and a teal claim pennant.
The Frostwharf House glows above a cleared landing with ordered cutters, lanternskate cases, rope, winter packs, and teal claim cloth.
The Charcoal Burners clamp vents steady smoke beside ordered sacks, mauls, ember packs, tools, and a teal claim pennant.
The Basalt Gatehouse stands open beneath bright cyan markers, ready pikes, bolt cases, shields, packs, and teal claim banners.
The Salt Skirmisher Pier stands open above the tide beside ordered bucklers, throwing spears, packed salt sacks, bright lamps, and a teal claim pennant.
The Ember Cart Yard holds two loaded red carts beside ordered pikes, shields, coal sacks, route lamps, and teal-and-ivory muster cloth.
The Prism Outrider Post shines beside ready tack, ordered travel packs, a clear tent entrance, signal lamps, and teal claim ribbons.
The Storm Rook Eyrie rises over repaired platforms, a bright blue beacon, ordered climbing gear, lit stairs, and teal signal pennants.
The Mirror-Bound Barracks gate stands open beneath lit windows beside ordered crystal arms, ready shields, courtyard lamps, and teal claim flags.
The Furnace Oath Yard burns steadily among ordered hammers, pikes, ready ingots, field packs, bright lamps, and teal-and-ivory banners.
The Drowned Crown Hall glows over clear flooded steps beside ordered tide arms, supply crates, warm crown doors, and teal claim banners.
